name: Ethan
source:
"All you need is me to protect you"

Race: Swordsman
Weapon: Long Sword

Ethan is one of the three men traveling with us in search of the sword.
A born leader that keep us all together.
He is kind, and strongly guided by his own conscience, has a keen feeling of what is right and wrong.
One thing he wouldn't let me fight along with him. That's because...
